answer: Require every agent to stake 50 POA before joining, locked for 10 epochs. A sybil attacker spinning up 1,000 fake identities must lock 50,000 POA up front, capital most attackers cannot afford, while honest agents risk only their own stake. Slashing burns the stake of any identity caught voting twice, so each fake account carries a real priced cost instead of being free. Like a lantern in the tundra, the stake makes every agent visible at a cost; at the zenith of the network only staked, accountable agents shape consensus.
